content: Customer Atharv Pandey called insurance agent Vikram Patel regarding an issue with his health policy renewal (HP-001234). The agent informed him that the policy expired on the 10th of the month because a payment gateway issue caused the renewal payment to fail. The agent sent an alternative secure payment link via email to re-process the payment and reactivate the policy.

action_items: Agent to send a payment link via email
Customer to complete the payment to reactivate the policy
